senses.gloss: m. (רשש) rashon, a species of locusts (= b. h. סָלְעָם).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 65a:9">Ḥull. 65ᵃ</cite>; Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 3, ch. V; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 537:14">Yalk. Lev. 537</cite>.
Ḥull. 65ᵇ חרגול זה ר׳ ḥargol (Lev. XI, 22) means rashon. Ib. 66ᵃ.

Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ top איזהו … כל שתחלת ברייתו דומה לר׳ what is the articulated embryo of which they speak? One that in its early stage resembles the shape of a rashon; Tosef. Nidd. IV, 10 ברושם (Var. בראשו, corr. acc.); Bab.

<cite ref="Niddah 25a:8">Nidd. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כר׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מראשו</he>, corr. acc.); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:8">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>צורת … דומה לר׳</he> how is the embryo formed? At first it resembles &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 547:1">Yalk. ib. 547</cite>.
